title: 实验室里的安全设备
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/02_Safety Equipment Lab Safety Video Part 2.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/02_Safety Equipment Lab Safety Video Part 2/src.py

points.K4: 喷淋和洗眼器每周测试
points.K8: 洗眼器：撑开眼睑冲洗10分钟
points.K9: 火灾四类：A类普通可燃物

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室墙边，身旁是洗眼器、紧急喷淋和灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands by a lab wall next to an eyewash station, an emergency shower and a red fire extinguisher, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全系列第二课：实验室安全设备。

shots.scene: 一只玻璃烧杯摔落在地面上碎开的慢镜头
shots.prompt_en: A slow-motion shot of a glass beaker falling onto the lab floor and shattering. No people.
shots.narration: 意外，往往就在一瞬间。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天来新实验室，背着手四处张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student arrives at a new lab on his first day and looks around curiously.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次来这间实验室。

shots.scene: 小研带着阿杰沿墙走，指着墙上的设备
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks the young male student along the lab wall and points at the safety equipment.
shots.narration: 小研说：先跟我认认这些设备。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室里出镜，身旁一个问号图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera in the lab with a question mark icon beside it.
shots.narration: 事故，本来就是预料不到的。

shots.scene: 一本空白安全手册图标，旁边的警示三角变小
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank safety handbook next to a warning triangle that shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 但懂安全知识，能降低出事的可能。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手打开墙上的急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand opens a wall-mounted first aid kit. No faces.
shots.narration: 万一出事，安全设备能救命。

shots.scene: 镜头依次扫过挂着检查卡的灭火器、急救箱和疏散平面图
shots.prompt_en: The camera pans past a fire extinguisher with a blank inspection tag, a first aid kit and a blank evacuation floor plan. No people.
shots.narration: 第一次进实验室，先找到安全设备。

shots.section_title: 喷淋和洗眼器每周测试
shots.scene: 墙上的安全淋浴标志和洗眼器标志，下面是对应设备
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign and an eyewash sign on the wall above a pull-handle safety shower and an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 每个实验室都必须有喷淋和洗眼器。
overlay: 喷淋和洗眼器每周测试

shots.section_title: 喷淋和洗眼器每周测试
shots.scene: 老李拉下喷淋拉杆放水，水流进下方挂着的布袋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls the shower handle to test it; water flows into a cloth bag hung below.
shots.narration: 两样都要每周测试一次。

shots.section_title: 喷淋和洗眼器每周测试
shots.scene: 老李按下洗眼器推板，在空白记录表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the eyewash paddle, then signs a blank inspection log on the wall.
shots.narration: 确认工作正常，水是干净的。

shots.scene: 液体溅向人手臂和胸前的图标，旁有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a chemical splash hitting a person's arm and chest, with a small flame icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 被化学品溅到，或者碰到火焰，

shots.scene: 阿杰大声呼救，快步冲向紧急喷淋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shouts for help and hurries to the nearest emergency shower.
shots.narration: 大声呼救，马上到最近的喷淋下。

shots.scene: 阿杰在喷淋下，拉起喷淋帘，脱下浸湿的实验服
shots.prompt_en: Under the running emergency shower, the young male student pulls a privacy curtain and takes off his soaked lab coat.
shots.narration: 脱掉被化学品浸透的衣物，

shots.scene: 水流冲洗手臂皮肤的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of shower water rinsing a forearm thoroughly. No people.
shots.narration: 在喷淋下把沾到的皮肤彻底冲透。

shots.scene: 衣服着火的人站到喷淋下全身淋湿的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person with flames on clothing standing under a shower, water covering the whole body. No people.
shots.narration: 衣服或皮肤着火，全身都要淋湿。

shots.scene: 小研拿手机拨号，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dials on a mobile phone with a blank screen while staying near the shower.
shots.narration: 再让别人拨打911。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器：撑开眼睑冲洗10分钟
shots.scene: 小研扶着捂住一只眼的阿杰走到洗眼器前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student guides the young male student, who covers one eye, to the eyewash station.
shots.narration: 危险化学品进了眼睛，用洗眼器。
overlay: 洗眼器：撑开眼睑冲洗10分钟

shots.section_title: 洗眼器：撑开眼睑冲洗10分钟
shots.scene: 阿杰俯身，双手扶住洗眼器，撑开眼睑让水流冲眼
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over the eyewash station, holding it with both hands, eyelids held open as two water jets rinse his eyes.
shots.narration: 撑开眼睑，彻底冲洗。

shots.section_title: 洗眼器：撑开眼睑冲洗10分钟
shots.scene: 时钟图标旁边，水流不断
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon next to the running eyewash water jets. No people.
shots.narration: 至少冲洗10分钟。

shots.section_title: 火灾四类：A类普通可燃物
shots.scene: 欣欣站在墙上的灭火器旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a fire extinguisher mounted on the wall.
shots.narration: 火灾分成四类。
overlay: 火灾四类：A类普通可燃物

shots.section_title: 火灾四类：A类普通可燃物
shots.scene: 垃圾桶和木头燃烧的图标，标着A
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning trash can and wood, with a large letter A beside it. No people.
shots.narration: A类是木头、布、纸这些普通可燃物。

shots.section_title: 火灾四类：A类普通可燃物
shots.scene: 水桶和灭火器图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a water bucket and a fire extinguisher with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 用水或通用灭火器就能扑灭。

shots.scene: 油桶和液体燃烧的图标，标着B
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning oil drum and liquid, with a large letter B beside it. No people.
shots.narration: B类是有机溶剂和易燃液体着火。

shots.scene: 插头冒电火花的图标，标着C
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug giving off electric sparks, with a large letter C beside it. No people.
shots.narration: C类是电气设备着火。

shots.scene: 泡沫灭火器喷出泡沫盖住火焰的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a foam fire extinguisher covering flames with a blanket of foam. No people.
shots.narration: B类C类要用化学泡沫灭火器闷灭。

shots.scene: 往着火的溶剂和插座上泼水的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of water being thrown on a burning solvent and a sparking socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 泼水只会更糟，火会蔓延，还会触电。

shots.scene: 一小块金属燃烧的图标，标着D
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a small piece of burning metal with a dim glow, with a large letter D beside it. No people.
shots.narration: D类是可燃金属着火，实验室不常见。

shots.scene: 出口门旁墙上挂着干粉灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A dry chemical fire extinguisher hangs on the wall beside the lab exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 多数实验室配干粉灭火器，装在出口旁。

shots.scene: 干粉灭火器旁A、B、C三个火灾图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A dry chemical extinguisher icon with three fire type icons beside it, all with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉对A、B、C三类火都有效。

shots.scene: 火势变大的图标，旁边一个向外的箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a growing fire with a large arrow pointing toward an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 火太大，扑不灭，

shots.scene: 小研招呼大家撤离，阿杰跟着跑出实验室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student waves everyone out, and the young male student follows her running out of the lab.
shots.narration: 立即疏散所有人，拨打911。

shots.scene: 室外训练场，消防员模样的老李指导学生拔下灭火器保险销
shots.prompt_en: On an outdoor training yard, the facility engineer dressed as a fire instructor shows a student how to pull the extinguisher safety pin.
shots.narration: 没受过培训，别去碰灭火器。

shots.scene: 学生在指导下对着训练火盘喷射干粉
shots.prompt_en: Under instruction, the student sprays dry chemical powder at a training fire pan on the yard.
shots.narration: 要由当地消防部门这样的专业人员培训。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研在门边展开一条灰色灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the female graduate student unfold a grey fire blanket by the lab door.
shots.narration: 灭火毯能盖灭台面和地上的小火。

shots.scene: 灭火毯盖住台面小火的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fire blanket smothering a small fire on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 也能帮衣服着火的人。

shots.scene: 站着的人被毯子裹住、火焰向上的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a standing person wrapped in a blanket with flames rising toward the head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别在人站着时裹毯子，火会窜向头颈。

shots.scene: 老周用灭火毯裹住躺在地上的阿杰，帮他翻滚
shots.prompt_en: The older man wraps the young male student, lying on the floor, in a fire blanket and helps him roll.
shots.narration: 扶他躺倒，裹住，帮他翻滚到火灭。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手打开急救箱，里面是绷带和消毒用品
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand opens a wall-mounted first aid kit showing bandages and antiseptic packs with blank labels. No faces.
shots.narration: 急救箱里有绷带和消毒品，处理小伤。

shots.scene: 门旁墙上一张空白平面图，红色箭头通向出口
shots.prompt_en: A blank evacuation floor plan on the wall by the door, with red arrows leading to the exits. No people.
shots.narration: 出口附近要贴疏散路线图。

shots.scene: 一条路线被障碍挡住，另一条路线亮起绿色
shots.prompt_en: On the floor plan icon, one route is blocked by a barrier and another route lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 多记几条路线，以防一条被堵。

shots.scene: 小研在化学通风柜里操作，蒸汽被吸走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a chemical fume hood; vapor from a beaker is drawn up and away.
shots.narration: 通风柜是通风的封闭工作区。

shots.scene: 有毒蒸汽线被吸进排风口的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of toxic vapor lines being pulled into an exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 能保护你不受有毒蒸气伤害。

shots.scene: 手指按下通风柜的排风开关，旁边风速表指针摆动
shots.prompt_en: A finger presses the exhaust fan switch on a fume hood panel, and an airflow gauge needle moves. No people.
shots.narration: 先打开排风机，确认排风正常。

shots.scene: 小研把通风柜视窗往下拉
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the fume hood sash down.
shots.narration: 开口由可以升降的视窗挡着。

shots.scene: 视窗边框上的两条标示线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the sash frame with two marked lines. No people.
shots.narration: 多数操作，视窗开8或16英寸。

shots.scene: 通风柜里堆满试剂瓶的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crowded with stored reagent bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别在通风柜里存放化学品。

shots.scene: 小研做完实验把棕色瓶子拿出来，擦干净台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student takes a brown bottle out of the hood and wipes the empty work surface.
shots.narration: 做完实验，清理干净，东西拿走。

shots.scene: 老李逐一检查喷淋、洗眼器、灭火器，在空白卡上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the shower, the eyewash station and the fire extinguisher one by one, ticking a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 定期测试，保证每件设备随时能用。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室里出镜，挥手示意
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot talks to the camera in the lab and gestures forward.
shots.narration: 下一课，我们讲实验室里的行为规范。

shots.scene: 洗眼器和喷淋图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station and an emergency shower with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋洗眼器每周测，冲眼至少10分钟。

shots.scene: A、B、C、D四个字母和干粉灭火器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the letters A, B, C and D next to a dry chemical extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 火分四类，B类C类不能用水。

shots.scene: 灭火毯和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire blanket and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 火大就撤，打911；裹毯先躺倒。

shots.scene: 通风柜视窗和排风图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood with its sash lowered and an airflow gauge in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜先开排风，不存放化学品。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在安全设备墙前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the wall with the eyewash station, shower and fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 认清设备，用对设备，下次见！
